title: Unflipped glTF normal texture with a UV-derived tangent frame and normalScale left at (1, 1)
fix_note: no fix merged (issue open); the fixed variant applies the issue's fix: normalScale computed from the texture's flipY, (1, -1) for flipY = false
expected_finding: the normal texture is uploaded unflipped (flipY = false, glTF +Y green with v = 0 at the top) and perturbNormal2Arb derives the bitangent from the UV derivatives, which for unflipped UVs points along -Y of the texture's convention; normalScale.y stays +1, so the green channel is applied inverted and the surface leans the wrong way
